description: Sous-stations des réseaux de chaleur d'Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. Product primarily intended for the location of substations and to be connected to the heating network or common table.Some substations are absent (undigitized), in particular those of the CPCU (Paris heating network). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Direct download service (WFS) of the dataset: Substations of the Île-de-France district heating networks" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WFS 1.1.0. The listing shows 2022-05-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
